pi.install_command: RUN curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.4/node-v22.23.4-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/node-v22.23.4-linux-x64.tar.xz && curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.4/SHASUMS256.txt -o /tmp/node-sums && (cd /tmp && grep ' node-v22.23.4-linux-x64.tar.xz$' node-sums | sha256sum -c -) && tar -xJf /tmp/node-v22.23.4-linux-x64.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/node-v22.23.4-linux-x64.tar.xz /tmp/node-sums && curl -fsSL http://127.0.0.1:35525/pi.sh | PI_INSTALLER_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:35525/pi sh
